Sort of like how GTA IV had optional phone calls you could make (meaning the NPC didn't call you, you had to initiate the phone call yourself) GTA V has a bunch of these.

This thread here on the GTAForums details the calls you can make to certain characters after certain missions.

In case you missed these on your playthrough, I put together some videos of most of the phone calls. I couldn't get all of them since - well, I'm not actually sure why. Sometimes you can make the call, other times you can't. It's completely random. Regardless, there's only a small handful missing.

Anyways, they're pretty nice and help open up the story a bit more, and helps form a rift between the protagonists and the antagonists.

If you have vision client on your school computer it will appear on the far right of your task bar as a lock (most of the time) and it will say if it is active or not. If your teacher actively enforces blocking your screen, disabling your internet, etc. you can turn off the program by going to start and clicking shut down and spamming escape or hitting cancel as soon as the client has closed. This will make your computer screen appear black on their end and if your on a laptop you could pull out other work or a book to make it appear as if your computer is off.
